description: FAFA ONE approved commit deployment only; no arbitrary command parameter

runCommand: if [ "{{ Action }}" = "check" ]; then git rev-parse HEAD; docker ps --all --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=fafa-one --format json; exit 0; fi

case "$remote" in git@github.com:fafa920q-hue/fafa|git@github.com:fafa920q-hue/fafa.git|https://github.com/fafa920q-hue/fafa|https://github.com/fafa920q-hue/fafa.git) ;; *) echo "Unapproved repository origin" >&2; exit 1;; esac

if bash infra/scripts/deploy-production.sh "{{ CommitSHA }}" deploy > "$deployment_log" 2>&1; then tail -n 1 "$deployment_log"; else echo "Deployment failed; protected server log retained, no raw output copied to SSM."; exit 1; fi
